scenarios.name: Clue Murder Mystery
scenarios.scenario:
Mr. Boddy was just found, deceased, in the Great Room. The circumstances of his death are quite peculiar, and the police suspect it must have been murder! Several suspects have been identified, and it up to you to put the clues together to find out what you can about these suspects. This information will become critical to solve the crime. 

[Note to designers: In this scenario you will need to add one "final" clue after the puzzle is solved to have the user solve the mystery. For example you can say the police identified the rope as the murder weapon, and therefore whoever had the rope must be the murder]
